(AP Photo/Julia Demaree Nikhinson)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveShohei Ohtani leads the LA Dodgers against the Arizona Diamondbacks to open the 2026 season, with the Dodgers raising their 2025 World Series banner tonight. Series hero Yamamoto starts for LA, with Zac Galen on the bump for Arizona. The first pitch is scheduled for 5:30 p.m. PT/8:30 p.m. ET (6:30 p.m. MST) on Tuesday, March 26, and you can watch live on NBC as well as stream it on Peacock.What TV channel is the Dodgers vs. D-backs game on today, or is it streaming only?Today’s game is available on regular broadcast TV via NBC, and is also available to live stream on Peacock, NBC’s flagship streaming service. When: 5:30 p.m. PT/8:30 p.m. ET (6:30 p.m. MST) on Tuesday, March 26Where: Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, CATV channel: NBC, and streaming on PeacockHow to watch the game streaming live: You can watch this game today live for FREE with DirecTV (free trial).Another great option might be to check out the multitude of subscription options at Sling and buy an HDTV antenna. You can also sign up for Peacock Premium ($10.99/month) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Peacock app. To sign up, follow the sign-up instructions on the Peacock home page, and it will walk you through how to sign up quickly.
